title: Bounded receive slice 5: owned IDXv2 writer and quarantine-only publication with retention
outcome: Bounded receive slice 5: owned IDXv2 writer and quarantine-only publication with retention
acceptance: An owned IDXv2 writer produces 8+1024+N*28+40 bytes with checked arithmetic before allocation, CRC32 over exact packed bytes and standard pack/index digests; no native index-pack or fetch writer
After flush, pack and index are published no-clobber, then a final manifest/ready marker, then only the operation-owned quarantine incoming ref; readers require the marker and matched artifacts
The selected repository's objects, refs, index, worktree, FETCH_HEAD and config are unchanged, with no export/import baseline movement, push or SQLite import

Disk credit is freed only on confirmed removal; cumulative network/decode credit never returns; the Ready handle carries operation, pinned object id and algorithm, profile, target, validation version, artifact identities and final counters
